analysis.primary: Equally weighted mean of every registered checkpoint success within each seed.
analysis.interactions: Calculate (E+1-E)-(ACS2 r(g)-ACS2) and (S+1-S)-(E+1-E) within each seed before the marginal 95% t(19) interval.

labels.floor: No arm lower 95% final-mean bound exceeds the exact test floor.
labels.too_easy: ACS2 across-seed mean at 1k >= 0.9 * test ceiling.
labels.ceiling: Both compared final means >= 0.99. For interactions use their two per-goal arms.

analysis.exclusions: Per group and contrast: floor always, too easy only for primary, ceiling only for final. Labels never remove table rows.
analysis.verdict: n counted mazes; A+ counts CI low>0, A- counts CI high<0. If n=0 not assessed; improves/worsens if its sign count >= ceil(n/2) and opposite=0; mixed if both signs occur; otherwise no clear effect/difference.
analysis.all_mazes: Report A+, A- and n over all 28 without a verdict.
analysis.sustained_095: First registered checkpoint in environment steps whose across-seed mean and all later checkpoint means are >=0.95; no interpolation; otherwise not reached.
analysis.reference_check: E+1-E, S+1-S and copies x values on the original six reproduce the earlier registered intervals, without replacing earlier verdicts.
analysis.post_hoc: Every other comparison, per-pair mechanism analysis, success by distance, G and R comparisons.

forecast.interval_kind: Conditional scenario range, not a confidence interval or a guaranteed cost bound.
forecast.training_model: Measure 10k--30k training CPU/step. Full archive factors are the observed mean post-30k rate divided by that late-pilot rate. Longer stopped attempts use measured post-30k CPU plus a constant last rate (low scenario) or continued nonnegative log-rate growth (high scenario). For each full reference, normalize the observed post-30k rate to the seed42 late-pilot rate on that same archived maze, retaining joint seed-level variation and growth. Take min and max across matching-arm full and longer evidence, including a constant-rate factor of one.
forecast.evaluation_model: Preserve measured first-four evaluation CPU; future checkpoints use observed minimum and maximum evaluation-cost factors from full references normalized to their same-maze seed42 30k evaluation cost and from longer attempts, with nonnegative power continuation for the latter. Normalize attributed CPU to exact wait4 process CPU and add allocation overhead; upper overhead scales with checkpoint count.
forecast.reference_policy: 120 full archive curves per arm over the original six mazes and 20 seeds, plus three longer stopped curves per arm. ACS2 r(g) uses ACS2 full-archive growth factors and its own three stopped curves, with per-goal overhead measured by its own fresh pilot.
forecast.censoring: A stopped attempt with no post-30k checkpoint contributes no observed post-30k growth factor. Its exact spent allocation remains an observed lower bound for that cell. Prefix equality is required before longer evidence is admitted.
forecast.limitations: One fresh cost seed and cross-maze growth transfer do not bound seed variance or unobserved late changes. All seeds retain per-pair evaluation cost conservatively; compact runs receive no unmeasured discount. The 25% requested-limit margin is operational, not statistical.

values: Classifier-local r/ir per maze goal, current-goal training/greedy policy, bootstrap and per-pair profiles. Covering r=0 and initial_ir; general initial_r/initial_ir; ALP inheritance for every goal, removal drops entries, subsumption retains owner values. Shared r/ir are inert. GA and restore are rejected.
model: Online ACS2 r(g) retains ACS2 delayed action-set updates, order, timing, q, marks, numerosity, ALP, covering, subsumption and truncation; fixed thesis preset. Existing five arms remain unchanged.
archive_policy: Reuse original ACS2/E/S/E+1/S+1 full archives on the original six mazes. The fresh 30k cost pilot is not a completed full run; every new full cell still needs seeds42--61. No continuation/restore from stopped models.

execution.limits: Proposed per-cell limits are in forecast.cells, grouped only at equal limits so the registered hard reservation sum is preserved.
execution.admission: Before every sbatch derive manifests from approved plan bytes; check grant and test-only; retain source, binary, hardware and allocation guards. STOP on real failure. Pilot, all attempts, spent allocations and remaining/new reservations fit the separately approved cumulative CPU-hour limit.
execution.archives: Results outside checkout, remote ~/tu_runs/per-goal-reward-ablation and local ~/Desktop/tu-runs/per-goal-reward-ablation; two checksum-verified copies.

authorization: Stage1 ends with this plan and cost-only forecast. No full-grid run or seed beyond the cost pilot without explicit approval of plan bytes and a cumulative CPU-hour limit. Full protocols and 2M/4M budgets remain unchanged.
